brand.name: Toyer Hair
brand.subtitle: Professional African Beauty Salon
brand.tone: Elegant, Immersive, Premium, Culturally Rich, Professional
brand.design_philosophy: Fusion of premium cinematic luxury and rich organic warmth. The experience should feel like walking into a high-end salon: dark, moody, warm lighting with stunning visual details.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold

rules: Headings must use Cormorant Garamond, tracking-tighter, leading-none.
Body text uses Outfit for modern, clean legibility.
Never use default 'Bold' for headings. Use font-light or font-medium for a high-fashion editorial look.
Overlines and small labels must be uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use #120D0A as the main background. It is a deep espresso black, giving a rich, warm, luxurious feel.
Text should be #F8F5F1 (Warm Cream) to reduce eye strain compared to pure white.
Primary actions (Book Now, Add to Cart) use the Soft Amber Gold (#C79A63).
Use 1px borders (rgba(248, 245, 241, 0.08)) to define cards and surfaces instead of heavy drop shadows.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12, p-24.

grids.marketing: Asymmetric Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Use col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create tension.
grids.scheduler: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-12 (2 columns for calendar/time slots, 1 column for summary)

rules: Never perfectly center everything. Use asymmetric alignments for visual interest.
Images should not exceed 80vh height on mobile to prevent blocking content.
Use massive negative space between distinct sections.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: MUST use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is critical for the 'immersive' requirement.

animations.reveal: Framer Motion. Initial { opacity: 0, y: 30 }, animate { opacity: 1, y: 0 } with transition { duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }.
animations.stagger: List items (products, features, calendar slots) should stagger in.
animations.parallax: Hero images and large section background images should have subtle parallax scroll effects.
animations.hover: Images subtly scale up (scale-105) on hover with a slow transition duration (duration-700). Buttons use a sleek color fill or translation effect.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground px-8 py-4 rounded-none uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-sm hover:bg-[#D4A870] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: border border-border text-foreground px-8 py-4 rounded-none uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-sm hover:bg-surface transition-colors

cards.style: Cardless or minimal 1px border. bg-surface border border-border p-6. No heavy box-shadows.

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-border rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 transition-colors placeholder:text-white/30

navigation.style: Sticky or Fixed header. Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#120D0A]/70 border-b border-white/5.
navigation.links: text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors

scheduler.style: Customized Shadcn Calendar. Override styles to match the dark theme and square corners. Highlight available slots with border-primary and dim unavailable ones.

image_urls.description: Stunning portrait of a black woman with natural afro hair. Use for the main hero section with a gradient overlay.
Profile of a black woman with a braided ponytail against a warm background.
Black woman with beautiful braided hair portrait.
Luxury salon interior. Use as a background for the appointment/booking section.

image_handling: Hero image MUST have a max overlay opacity of bg-black/50, preferably a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#120D0A] via-[#120D0A]/40 to-transparent).
Images should use grayscale or sepia CSS filters on hover to match the luxurious dark aesthetic.
Use next/image or standard img tags with object-cover and w-full h-full.

attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-appointment-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Next.js (or React/Vite) hybrid app containing landing, shop, and booking features.
Install and setup Lenis for smooth scrolling.
Install and use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrance animations.
Install Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react for iconography.
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. Apply custom fonts via Google Fonts.
Ensure 'Toyer Hair' title uses a stylish, large Cormorant Garamond font setup.
The Booking calendar should be functional visually (mock backend if needed but show time slots visually).
Products page should look like a luxury e-commerce catalog.
